title: setDefaultConfig
subtitle: Set default configuration
description: Set global default configuration options for all queries. These defaults will be applied to all queries unless overridden by specific query options.

rows.description: Configuration object with default options to apply to all queries.

callouts.title: Global Configuration
callouts.content: setDefaultConfig is perfect for setting application-wide defaults that work for most of your queries.

callouts.title: Setting Global Configuration
callouts.content: Call setDefaultConfig early in your application lifecycle, ideally before any queries are executed. This ensures all queries inherit your preferred defaults from the start.
